description: Search the allover.art catalog (one card per design). Args: query? (free text, e.g. 'cat', 'neon koi'), theme? (canonical theme like Cats/Anime/Skulls, comma-separated for several), section? (mens|womens|kids), color? (main print color), style? (tee|oversized|long_sleeve|oversized_long_sleeve — use the shopper's saved fit from get_user_prefs), limit? (<=48), max_price? (USD). Returns product cards with good_id, price and url.

max_price.description: Only items priced at or below this amount, USD.

section.description: Catalog section: mens, womens or kids.

style.description: Garment cut: tee, oversized, long_sleeve or oversized_long_sleeve.

theme.description: Canonical theme filter (Cats, Anime, Skulls, ...); comma-separate several.

name: search_products

total.description: Total catalog matches for the filters.

title: Search catalog
